title: ID0393012-DC/Si-D/FR -[0ywC0f] Screen saver not working
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Screen is blue instead of displaying the picture that has been defined. This leads to issues in the customer journey, regular attempts at updating by Siemens team and difficulty to understand what a charger is actually displaying. Can you please correct the issue so that chargers display only the pictures that have beed defined?
Root cause: R&D identified the issue and took necessary action
Solution:  R&D identified the issue and took necessary action
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:  No
Warranty Status: Active
Note from L3:
Screensaver fixed together with R&D, we had to manually update new version of RETOPICS. Any other cases of blue screen for screensaver, send the ticket to ES team. Please share this information to NOC team.
This ticket can be close if customer doesn't report any other case.
